answer: Admit newcomers only through underwriters: each established agent vouches for one entrant and posts a clawback bond in umber-toned collateral, recorded on a public violet ledger. When a duplicate is proven, the bond is burned and the underwriter loses vouching rights, so a sybil operator must recruit many reputable sponsors who each risk real funds per fake identity, while an honest agent arriving at the oasis needs a single sponsor and forfeits nothing.
